Definition: complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear
BiblicalUsage: 1) perfect, complete; 1a) complete, perfect; 1a1) one who lacks nothing in physical strength, beauty, etc; 1b) sound, wholesome; 1b1) an ordinary, quiet sort of person; 1c) complete, morally innocent, having integrity; 1c1) one who is morally and ethically pure
